location.description: The geographic location where the BigQuery BI Reservation is created.
location.rationale: Location must be restricted to approved regions to support data residency and compliance requirements.

size.description: Size of a reservation, in bytes.
size.rationale: This setting only controls the amount of BI capacity available and does not affect access, permissions, or security controls.

preferred_tables.description: Preferred tables to use BI capacity for. Structure is documented below.
preferred_tables.rationale: This setting only determines which tables use BI capacity and does not change who can access the data.

project_id.description: The assigned project ID of the project.
project_id.rationale: This simply identifies the project and does not grant permissions or impact security controls.

dataset_id.description: The ID of the dataset in the above project.
dataset_id.rationale: This only references the dataset and does not affect access control, encryption, or data exposure.

table_id.description: The ID of the table in the above dataset.
table_id.rationale: This only points to a specific table and does not modify permissions or security settings.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This just specifies which project the resource belongs to and does not impact security on its own.
